legend: We all know the impressive story of Robin Hood. Robin Hood uses his archery skills and his wits to steal the money from rich, and return it to the poor.

There are n citizens in Kekoland, each person has ci coins. Each day, Robin Hood will take exactly 1 coin from the richest person in the city and he will give it to the poorest person (poorest person right after taking richest's 1 coin). In case the choice is not unique, he will select one among them at random. Sadly, Robin Hood is old and want to retire in k days. He decided to spend these last days with helping poor people.

After taking his money are taken by Robin Hood richest person may become poorest person as well, and it might even happen that Robin Hood will give his money back. For example if all people have same number of coins, then next day they will have same number of coins too.
Your task is to find the difference between richest and poorest persons wealth after k days. Note that the choosing at random among richest and poorest doesn't affect the answer.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 500 000, 0 ≤ k ≤ 109) — the number of citizens in Kekoland and the number of days left till Robin Hood's retirement.
The second line contains n integers, the i-th of them is ci (1 ≤ ci ≤ 109) — initial wealth of the i-th person.
output: Print a single line containing the difference between richest and poorest peoples wealth.
note: Lets look at how wealth changes through day in the first sample.
In second sample wealth will remain the same for each person.

output.ai: 输出一行，包含最富有的人与最贫穷的人的财富之差。

note.ai: 让我们看看第一个样例中财富在一天中的变化情况。
在第二个样例中，每个人的财富都将保持不变。

legend.ai: 我们都知道罗宾汉的传奇故事。罗宾汉利用他的箭术和智慧，从富人那里偷取钱财，并将其归还给穷人。
Kekoland 中有 n 位市民，每个人拥有 c_i 枚硬币。每天，罗宾汉会从城中最富有的人那里恰好拿走 1 枚硬币，并将其交给最贫穷的人（这里的最贫穷者指拿走最富有者的 1 枚硬币之后的最贫穷者）。如果选择不唯一，他会从中随机选择一人。遗憾的是，罗宾汉年事已高，想在 k 天后退休。他决定把最后这些日子用来帮助穷人。
罗宾汉拿走硬币后，原本最富有的人也可能变成最贫穷的人，甚至可能发生罗宾汉把硬币还给他的情况。例如，如果所有人的硬币数都相同，那么第二天他们的硬币数也会相同。
你的任务是求 k 天后最富有者与最贫穷者的财富差。注意，在最富有者和最贫穷者不唯一时进行随机选择不会影响答案。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ n ≤ 500000，0 ≤ k ≤ 10^9）——Kekoland 中的市民数量，以及距离罗宾汉退休剩余的天数。
第二行包含 n 个整数，其中第 i 个整数为 c_i（1 ≤ c_i ≤ 10^9）——第 i 个人的初始财富。
